question: Should OpenClaw approve PR #99193's exact-head ACPX dependency graph update from acpx 0.11.2 to 0.12.0 for the Grok Build target?
rationale: The branch depends on a new upstream ACPX release and lockfile changes from an external contributor; repository policy treats dependency graph changes as maintainer/security-owned even when the code diff looks correct.

options.title: Approve exact head
options.body: Approve the dependency update for head 6b66426470ec15e8289a91cd7dff791c24318f5d after reviewing the acpx 0.12.0 package delta and then proceed with normal merge checks.

options.title: Regenerate from maintainer branch
options.body: Have a maintainer regenerate the acpx 0.12.0 package and lockfile changes on a trusted branch before merging equivalent docs and routing changes.

options.title: Pause the target
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it until Grok Build ACPX support can be accepted without changing the dependency graph from an external branch.

recommendation.title: Approve exact head
recommendation.body: Approve the dependency update for head 6b66426470ec15e8289a91cd7dff791c24318f5d after reviewing the acpx 0.12.0 package delta and then proceed with normal merge checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest visible owner from recent ACPX lease/runtime history touched by this PR.
